Hannah — thanks, and really excited to partner on this. I put together a short MAP and the acceptance checklist below (also attached as an editable spreadsheet: pilot-greenlight-checklist.xlsx). High level: we recommend a 4-week pilot starting Jan 11 with three decision gates (integration, performance baseline, user acceptance).

Summary of what Redwood needs from CareNet before kickoff:
- API access: dev API key + sandbox dataset (anonymized) for smoke tests (owner: CareNet Eng)
- Sample traffic: 10k sample interactions or 24h replay to establish baseline (format guidance in sheet)
- Whitelisted IPs for VPC egress if on Private plan (if applicable)
- Primary contacts: Product (Hannah), Eng (Mike A.), Procurement (procurement@carenet.com)

Pilot timeline (weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-boarding): exchange credentials, sign MAP (DocuSign link), schedule kickoff call
- Week 1 (integration & sanity): API integration, schema validation, smoke tests run by Redwood (target 3 business days)
- Week 2 (performance baseline): collect traffic, measure latency/throughput/consistency, quantize cost estimates
- Week 3 (quality & end-user sampling): targeted UX sessions, concordance tests against golden set, safety filters validation
- Week 4 (go/no-go): final runbook, customer signoff or rollback plan; decision meeting with execs

Acceptance thresholds (greenlight criteria) — all must be met for a go decision:
1) Stability & latency: 95th percentile latency <= 500ms for standard prompts at target throughput (target TP: 20 reqs/s)
2) Functional correctness: >= 92% pass rate on the golden test set (annotated examples) with no critical hallucination cases (>0.5% critical errors)
3) Throughput: sustained throughput within 15% of predicted capacity for 30m during baseline window
4) Cost envelope: projected incremental inference cost per 1k tokens within 20% of estimate provided in week 2
5) Security & compliance: SOC2 evidence + required data-retention policy alignment confirmed; outstanding security issues must be in recorded remediation plan
6) Integration: end-to-end request/response logging (masked per policy) and KV cache sizing validated for session workloads

Acceptance tests (owners & pass/fail):
- Smoke tests (Redwood): connectivity, auth, basic response sanity — PASS if all endpoints respond and no 5xx in 100 calls
- Golden-set concordance (CareNet/Redwood): run 250 curated prompts; PASS if >=92% match on expected label/intent and reviewer notes <3 high-severity mismatches (owner: CareNet QA)
- Latency/throughput bench (Redwood): 30-minute sustained load using target profile; PASS if 95p latency <=500ms and error rate <1%
- Safety and PII scan (Redwood + CareNet): automated test harness to detect PII leakage; PASS if no PII exfiltration and any flagged items have remediation tickets

Roll/rollback triggers: any critical production-safety regression, repeated 5xx spikes exceeding 1% in two successive 30m windows, or security blockers unresolved at decision meeting -> roll to iterate with prioritised action items.

Deliverables and evidence list for procurement/security:
- Completed MAP (mutual-action-plan-signed.pdf)
- SOC2 summary & pen-test report (we’ll provide redacted extracts)
- Smoke-tests.yml run logs (we’ll share post-smoke)
- Runbook for escalation and SLA expectations

3) Ben — can you confirm pricing/discount and whether we need ERTs or sandbox credits for the pilot? Marissa — can you confirm CS coverage for week 3 UAT sessions?
